Landscaping & groundworks

Make the whole
garden work.

Paving, lawns, artificial grass and shed bases. Talk to NN Paving about the practical changes that bring your outdoor space together.

A joined-up approach to your outside space.

Think beyond an individual path or patio. The relationship between paving, lawn, boundaries and usable space is what makes a garden feel complete. NN Paving’s published services cover both surface finishes and groundwork.

Turf & lawns

Add a fresh lawn to complement your paving. Discuss the existing ground, access and how you use the garden to help determine the right approach.

Artificial grass

Ask about artificial grass as part of your landscaping project. Discuss the look you want, preparation, drainage and ongoing care before choosing a finish.

Shed bases & groundwork

A practical garden needs a practical foundation. Bring the intended shed size, positioning and access details to your conversation with Leon.

Retaining features

Where changes in level are involved, discuss the groundwork and any retaining features as part of the overall scope. Requirements vary by site.

Planning your project

How much will my driveway or patio cost?

Every space is different. Size, materials, access, existing surfaces, drainage and the amount of groundwork all affect the cost. Ask for a quotation for your property rather than relying on a generic price per square metre.

How long does the work take?

Timing depends on project size, preparation, materials and weather. Discuss an estimated schedule and arrangements for access when requesting your quotation.

What guarantees and payment terms are offered?

Ask Leon to confirm any applicable workmanship or product guarantees, payment schedule and exclusions in writing with your quotation. Terms are project-specific; no fixed guarantee or finance plan is advertised on this website.
